one_line: Last great Gahadavala ruler of Kannauj and Varanasi, facing Muhammad of Ghor at Chandawar in 1194 CE.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, tall and athletic with a regal, battle-hardened build.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp nose, medium wheatish complexion, neatly trimmed moustache with a short pointed beard, a small tilak mark at the forehead, and a calm yet intense gaze with slightly narrowed anime-style eyes.
appearance.hair: Black hair pulled back into a low knot at the back of the head, partly hidden under a red silk turban wrapped in the north Indian style, with a narrow gold band and a small upward plume at the front.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late 12th-century north Indian royal-warrior attire: a long quilted cotton coat (padded kavacha) in deep maroon reaching just below the knees, with stitched vertical panels and brass stud detailing, worn over a cream-coloured long-sleeved tunic and tied with a broad golden-ochre cloth belt; below, indigo-blue fitted churidar-style trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots; over his shoulders a rich Varanasi-style silk shawl in muted gold with simple geometric borders in dark red, draped securely and pinned so it does not flap wildly; minimal armour plates—rectangular iron plates strapped over the chest and shoulders beneath the maroon coat so their edges just show, plus simple iron bracers on the forearms; jewellery limited to a single medium-thickness gold necklace, a pair of small round gold earrings, and a simple signet ring, keeping the overall look dignified and practical.
appearance.signature: A long Indian straight sword (khanda) with a broad double-edged blade, iron basket hilt with a small disc pommel and knuckle guard, worn at his left hip in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings.

ref_desc: Jaichand Gahadavala is a tall, athletic north Indian king with wheatish oval face, trimmed moustache-beard, red turban over tied-back black hair, wearing a deep maroon quilted coat over cream tunic, indigo trousers, muted gold shawl, minimal visible armour and brown boots, carrying a khanda sword at his left hip in a dark leather scabbard with brass fittings and dominated by maroon, cream, indigo, muted gold and brown colours.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Jaichand Gahadavala, showing him front and three-quarter views as a dignified late 12th-century north Indian king-warrior: tall and athletic with an oval wheatish face, sharp nose, neatly trimmed moustache with a short pointed beard, and a calm, intense gaze in slightly narrowed eyes; his black hair is pulled into a low knot at the back, mostly hidden by a red silk turban wrapped in a historical north Indian style with a narrow gold band and a small upward plume at the front. He wears a long deep maroon quilted cotton war coat with stitched vertical panels and brass stud detailing, reaching just below his knees, over a cream long-sleeved tunic, all tied at the waist with a broad golden-ochre cloth belt. Beneath, show indigo-blue fitted trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots; the edges of simple rectangular iron plates should be just visible at the chest and shoulders under the maroon coat, with plain iron bracers on his forearms. Over his shoulders drape a muted gold Varanasi-style silk shawl with dark red geometric border patterns, pinned so it lies securely and does not fly loose. Add restrained jewellery: one medium gold necklace, small round gold earrings, and a single signet ring. At his left hip, clearly show his signature khanda sword in a dark brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, its broad straight blade and iron basket hilt visible in at least one view. Keep all colours grounded in deep maroon, cream, indigo blue, muted gold, and brown leather, and emphasise a consistent, re-drawable design suitable for action scenes while remaining historically plausible and fully clothed.
